findings: F1 (boundary, new): overpayment (delta<0) classifies as SETTLED_OK with credit_delta +5 — no OVERPAID class in /v1/reconcile, while /v1/verify-math does return OVERPAID semantics (MATCHED/SHORTFALL observed; OVERPAID per landing page). The spec comment (2026-11-21) defined COMPENSATED only for delta>0 and left delta<0 undefined; the actual behavior is deterministic but conflates overpayment with exact settlement at the same +5 credit.

F2 (trial design): reconcile accepts idempotency_key and returns idempotent_replay:false, but trial tier never deduplicates (persisted:false — nothing to compare against). Idempotency is a ledger-backed property -> confirmed as a paid-tier question (deferred A1/A7).

F3 (API drift <24h): between the 2026-11-22 recon (HTTP 200 with v0.1-era values) and the 2026-11-23 run the server introduced VERSION_MISMATCH validation requiring buyer_version == supplier_version (reciprocal declaration), and rule_version evolved v0.1 -> 0.1.0. The hash canonicalization itself remained stable (byte-exact offline recompute).
F4 (verify-math): amounts are numbers (floats in responses, 50000.0) — in contrast to the integer-KRW discipline of quote-lock/reconcile; tolerance field exists (default 0.0).
